shared_context: The first presidential debate of the 2008 election is scheduled for September 26, 2008, at the University of Mississippi. Both campaigns have been invited. As of September 1, 2008, neither campaign has publicly confirmed their candidate's participation. The debate is a major media event, and public confirmation is typically done through official statements or press releases.

starting_events.description: The simulation begins. Both campaigns are aware of the debate invitation and have not yet publicly confirmed participation.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff on 2008-09-26T12:00:00-05:00, the persistent event history shows that both the McCain campaign and the Obama campaign have issued a public statement (e.g., press release, official announcement) confirming their candidate's participation in the debate. Otherwise resolve NO.
